title: Bang the Drum Slowly
actors: Michael Moriarty, Robert De Niro, Vincent Gardenia
plot: The story of the friendship between the New York Mammoths major-league baseball team's worldly-wise pitcher Henry "Author" Wiggen and half-wit catcher Bruce Pearson as they cope with Bruce's terminal illness during a baseball season.
awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 2 wins & 1 nomination total
